philosophy: Life is a series of experiments. Some of them end, and that's fine, as long as you keep learning.

side_quests.name: Mockly
side_quests.description: Fake chat screenshots for 17+ platforms. Built it in a weekend, TechCrunch wrote about it, 10k people use it. I can't believe this is legal.

side_quests.name: Fluncle
side_quests.description: Drum & bass bangers from another dimension. It has a radio, an API, and an SSH rave terminal.

side_quests.name: Hackadam
side_quests.description: Monthly meetup in Amsterdam for indie makers building their own stuff.

side_quests.name: Nonobench
side_quests.description: Benchmark for how well LLMs solve nonogram puzzles. The top score went from 63% in February to 93% in September.

graveyard.name: Logistics system
graveyard.epitaph: Built at uni because my part-time job ran on spreadsheets and hope. Sold it six years later. Small exit, still proud.

graveyard.name: Subthread
graveyard.epitaph: Co-founded a studio, shipped dozens of AI products. Chatbots, recruitment pipelines, consumer apps. Learned how much AI can do for normal businesses.

graveyard.name: Onesixtyeight
graveyard.epitaph: Functional mushroom blend for focus. Turns out atoms are harder than bits.
